name: cp-v12
idea_origin: Comprobante line, 29 Oct: token accounting of the real DeepSeek traces (history grows ~608 tokens per model call, 431 of them tool results and framing; total tokens are quadratic in the number of model calls) plus the pending candidates c5 (quality), t0 (Skill from level 4), suelo-v1-min (stalled start, size of the risk) and v4-lean-q (one observe per quarter; Leah's branch leah/workspace, not a registered parent)
hypothesis: Same play as cp-v5a (identical story and quarterly rules) with a turn loop that pairs take_action + observe whatever the provider, and quarterly menu numbers learned from the run itself. Proposed by Alejandro on 29 Oct after the v8->v11 branch sank 3 of 5 games.
predicted_behaviour: Pair in >= 90 % of story replies on any provider; tokens per month under 0.7 M if completed; first quarter in two replies, later quarters in one; story and quarterly choices as cp-v5a (bank within v4 repeat noise). Game scores: the family distribution (about 66 when completed, one sink in five to seven).
refutation: Pairing below 60 % in a game, or a quarterly menu error, or choices that differ from cp-v5a on the L1 bank beyond v4 repeat noise.
change: cp-v5a with only its Turn loop section and the turn-loop sentences of the manifest replaced by cp-v10's (first three replies spelled out with the Continue screen as the first pair; silence "if you can" with the pair independent of text; first quarter Energy -> observe -> main action -> observe, later quarters in one reply). No other text changes: no cp-v8 exception, no level-5 quarter, no post-blow-up rule, no observation rewording.
